name: Warriors Army Simulator 2⚔️
desc:
In the world of monsters, you have to make your own army of warriors to fight them!

Welcome to Warriors Army Simulator 2 , A remastered version of our first game.

👾- Fight monsters to get coins.
🌳- Hire workers to get your resources.
🏰- Upgrade your castle and get more warriors!
🗺️- Discover new areas and places.
🛡️- Unlock tons of armors and weapons -🗡️
🐎- Get mounts to help you travel!


Update 4.6.0 ( 10/26/2025) :
- 🌍 New Halloween Area
- 🛡️6 New Armors
- ⚔️6 New Weapons
- 🎃 Limited Halloween Shop 🎃
- 🐉 Ghost Dragon is BACK 👻


Make sure to like 👍 and favourite ⭐ the game if you enjoy playing it

Don't forget to follow for updates!
